tasks.name: Prepare gear for LA shoot based on forecast
tasks.details:
Pack gear against the actual NWS forecast for 34.05, -118.24. Re-check the forecast the morning of the shoot — the data I have stops at Wednesday night.

TARGET WINDOW: Mon-Wed (75-76F, Sunny, wind 0-10 mph). Avoid today through Sunday: Light Rain today and tonight, Light Rain Likely Sunday. If the shoot must be earlier, plan it as a wet shoot.

SUNNY SHOOT KIT (75-76F day / 55-58F night):
- ND filter + polarizer: full sun at 75F gives hard, high-contrast light.
- Reflector and/or diffuser: harsh shadows on faces; a scrim is the most useful item here.
- Lens hood; plan for shade — no cloud cover to soften light.
- Sunscreen, hat, water: direct sun with no shade dehydrates fast while carrying gear.
- Warm layer for late sessions: evenings drop to 55-58F, cold standing still after sunset.
- Sandbag weights for light stands: wind is modest (0-10 mph) but not zero, peaking ~10 mph Sun and Wed night.
- Extra batteries and cards: cool evenings drain batteries faster.

IF WET (today-Sunday pattern, light rain, 68F):
- Rain cover for camera and lens, plus a dry bag.
- Several microfiber cloths — rain on the front element is constant.
- Umbrella or rain hood between shots.
- Footwear with grip for slick pavement; silica packets in the bag.

ALWAYS:
- Check NWS alerts the day before and morning of. No active LA basin alert right now, but that changes fast.
- Scout a covered backup location in case the Mon-Wed window moves.

OPEN ITEM: this forecast covers only through Wednesday night. A later shoot date has no forecast evidence from me and needs a fresh check.
